basic_info.description: Outer Sunset Semi-Detached Single Family Home with Permitted Rear Expansion. Rarely available 3 Bedrooms and 2 Bathrooms on the Main Level. Owned by same family for 60 years. Approx. 1,500 Square Feet. Additional 300 plus Square Feet unpermitted Lower Level Bonus room and Bathroom. Ready to Move-in with retro 1970's finishes or Renovate to Modern Decor and your choices. Hardwood Floors. 2 Car Tandem Garage. Rear yard ready to be landscaped. Close to schools, shopping, beach and Golden Gate Park.
